senses.gloss:
मुण् मुण्, cl. 6. P. मुणति, &c., to
promise.

मुण्ट् मुण्ट्, cl. 1. P. मुण्टति, &c., = rt.
मुट् above.

मुण्ठ् मुण्ठ्, cl. 1. A. मुण्ठते, &c., to
run away; to protect, (पालने being
given as a various reading for पलायने.)

मुण्ड् मुण्ड्, cl. 1. P. मुण्डति, &c., to
grind, (in this sense = rt. मुट् and con-
nected with rt. 1. मृद्); to shave, shear; cl. 1. A.
मुण्डते, मुण्डितुम्, to be pure; to sink; [cf.
Lat. mund-o, mundu-s.]

मुण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps connected with rt. 1.
मृद्), shaved, bald, having no hair on the head;
hornless, destitute of horns, having no horns (Ved.);
stripped of top leaves or branches, lopped (as a tree);
pointless, blunt; low, mean; (अस्), m. a man with
a shaved head; a bald or shaven head, bald pate,
shorn poll; the forehead; a tree stripped of its top
branches, the trunk of a lopped tree, a pollard; a
barber (= मुण्डक); N. of a king; of a Daitya;
an epithet of Rāhu; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people;
(आ), f. a (close-shaved) female mendicant; a species
of plant (= मुण्डीरिका); Bengal madder; (ई), f. a
species of plant (= महा-श्रावणिका); N. of one
of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; (अम्), n. the
head; iron [cf. मुण्ड-लोह, मुण्डायस]; myrrh.
—मुण्ड-चणक, अस्, m. a kind of pulse (=
कलाय).
—मुण्ड-धान्य, अम्, n. a kind of grain
(without awns; cf. मुण्ड-शालि).
—मुण्ड-पृष्-
ठ, N. of a place.
—मुण्ड-फल, अस्, m. a cocoa-
nut tree, (the fruit being one step towards a human
head made by Viśvāmitra when he proposed attempt-
ing a creation in opposition to that of Brahmā.)
—मुण्ड-मण्डली, f. a number of shaven heads; a
number of troops of an inferior description.
—मुण्ड-
माला, f. or मुण्डमाला-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a
Tantra.
—मुण्ड-मालिनी, f. a form of Durgā.
—मुण्ड-लोह, अम्, n. iron; [cf. अष्ट-लोहक,
मुण्डायस, मुण्डित.]
—मुण्ड-वेदाङ्ग, अस्,
m., N. of a serpent-demon.
—मुण्ड-शालि, इस्, m.
a species of rice.
—मुण्डाख्या (˚ड-आख्˚), f. a
species of plant (= महा-श्रावणिका).
—मुण्डा-
यस (˚ड-अय्˚), अम्, n. iron.
—मुण्डासन
(˚ड-आस्˚), अम्, n. a particular posture in sitting.
—मुण्डेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚ड-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of
a Tīrtha.

मुण्डक, अस्, m. the lopped trunk or stem of a
tree, a tree stripped of its branches; a shaver, barber;
(इका), f. a species of plant; (अम्), n. the head; N.
of the chapters into which the Muṇḍakopaniṣad is
divided.
—मुण्डकोपनिषद् (˚क-उप्˚), f., N. of
a well-known Upaniṣad of the Atharva-veda (con-
taining three short chapters or Muṇḍakas, each of
which comprises two sections or Khaṇḍas, and said
to take its name from the word मुण्ड because
every one who comprehends its secret doctrine is
‘shorn,’ i. e. liberated from all error, a similar idea
being probably involved in the name of the Kṣuri-
kopanishad or ‘Razor Upaniṣad:’ the Muṇḍaka
is one of the most interesting of the numerous Upa-
niṣads, on account of the reasons which it gives
for the superiority of these works over the Veda and
its ritual; thus, according to Muṇḍaka I. 4, there
are two sciences, the higher and the inferior; the
inferior is the knowledge of the Ṛg-veda, Yajur-
veda, Sāma-veda, Atharva-veda, pronunciation, ritual,
grammar, explanation of Vedic texts, prosody, and
the astronomical calendar; but the higher knowledge
is that by which the imperishable Brahma is com-
[]
prehended).
—मुण्डकोपनिषद्-दीपिका, f., N. of
a commentary on the above.

मुण्डन, अम्, n. shaving the head, tonsure;
protecting, defending, [cf. rt. मुण्ठ्.]

मुण्डनक, अस्, m. a species of rice, = मुण्ड-
शालि; (इका), f. in महा-म्˚, q. v.

मुण्डय, Nom. P. मुण्डयति, -यितुम्, to shave,
shear, cut off the hair, shave the head closely.

मुण्डार, अम्, n., N. of a place at which the sun
was worshipped.

मुण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaved, closely shaven, bald.
shorn, lopped; (अम्), n. iron; [cf. मुण्ड-लोह.]
—मुण्डित-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, shaven-headed, bald-
pated.

मुण्डितिका, f. a species of plant, (commonly
मुण्डीरी or मुण्डिनिका; cf. मुण्डन्क.)

मुण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shaven, close-shaved, bald; horn-
less, having no horns; (ई), m. an epithet of Śiva;
a barber.
—मुण्डीश्वर-तीर्थ (˚डि-ईश्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of a Tīrtha; [cf. दण्डि-मुण्डीश्वर.]

मुण्डिभ, अस्, m., Ved. a proper N., (the author
of Vājasaneyi-saṃhitā XXV. 9. is so called.)

मुण्डीरिका, f. a species of plant (= मुण्डा =
मुण्डितिका.]

मुण्डीरी, f. a species of plant (= श्रमणा, प्र-
व्रजिता).
